## Network
[Kabocha](https://kabocha.network)

## **Network Services**
[Decent Partners](https://decent.partners)

## **Summary**
This is a proposal to cover legal and compliance costs related to the launch of Kabocha's crowdloan. 

Some costs have already been incurred and have so far been paid by Decent Partners. 

We have taken advice here in the UK and are speaking to US law firms to ensure we approach the crowdloan in the most open, transparent and regulatory compliant manner that enables anyone, anywhere to take part. 

Our overall aim is to ensure that the project and its contributors can operate long into the future as sovereign systems with a primary focus on the public good.

## **Background**
Edgeware did not have run an ICO or raise funds directly from VCs, instead launching via [the lockdrop](https://medium.com/commonwealth-labs/whats-in-a-lockdrop-194218a180ca) with a [broad and fair public distribution](https://messari.io/pdf/smartcontracts-q3-2020.pdf). 
![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/3916cd05-efd1-4632-ab54-632f8680a879.1647984735084)
There was no foundation in this approach and the launch team Commonwealth Labs as issuers received a legal recommendation that Edgeware was likely not a security, but this is not a legal guarantee.
